## Episode progress boundaries and regression coverage

- Save pause/exit/episode-switch boundaries even during the first five seconds, but reject unstarted-backend snapshots.
- Save natural playback completion explicitly, including the final episode.
- Wait for local progress persistence before exiting or resolving a newly selected episode; boundary changes request urgent cloud sync.
- Add progress-boundary regression tests, application-wide JaCoCo reports and a strict 100% line/branch/method/class/instruction verification task.
- Preserve the requested 0.1.89 menu navigation rollback.

The whole application does not yet have 100% coverage. The strict verification task is expected to fail until the remaining tests are written; JVM unit coverage is not a substitute for TV/device regression tests.
